entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling because I need to return something. I feel awful about it, I've just had some unexpected expenses come up.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can certainly look into the return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for that new Trail Helmet. I was so excited for it, and I know your brand is top-tier for safety, which is why I always shop with you.
Thank you for that, I appreciate your loyalty. Let me pull up order VF88602... Okay, I see the Trail Helmet here. It looks like it was delivered about 35 days ago.

Yes, that sounds right. The box is still unopened. I didn't even take it out. The color was a little different than I expected from the website, and I just... I really need the money back right now. I hope that's okay.
Of course, it's perfectly fine. I'm checking our policy now... and yes, you're well within the 90-day return period for this helmet.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure?

Absolutely. Since the item is within 90 days of delivery, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file as we speak. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. You have no idea how much this helps me. I was so worried. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
